intro: For us, villa landscaping is part of the house. Zoya on Palm Jumeirah centres on an Arabian courtyard garden with an olive tree. Our garden design work in Dubai also includes AUREA, HARMONIA, MILA, Ayla and Miro, with Athena in Greece and the landscapes of Evergreens and Orel.

seo.title: Villa Landscaping & Garden Design, Dubai | Nellis
seo.description: Villa landscaping and garden design in Dubai by Nellis Architecture: courtyard gardens, terraces and pools on Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills and Umm Suqeim.
